newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates rise to end at 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates rise to end at 21 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates rose for the second consecutive day on Thursday in tighter liquidity but traders expected a downward movement to start on Friday.
Overnight rates finished at 21.00 percent, up from Wednesday's 20.375 percent closing.
"We will probably see the rates come down on Friday as significant funds will flow back from the central bank's reverse repo (facility)," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
Many market participants opted to put excess funds in the one-week reverse repo last Friday banking on a repo rate cut which did take place on that day.
